description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Samurai Mode I (Jack)] and [Fire Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Samurai Mode I (Jack)
description.text: Samurai abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Samurai abilities trigger 2 additional times, 50%/75%/100% additional critical chance for equipped Samurai abilities after using 1/2/3+ Samurai abilities, grants [Critical Damage +50% 1] to the user when a Samurai ability deals a critical hit

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1], [10% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] and [Dual Awoken Samurai Mode II (Jack)], removes [Dual Awoken Samurai Mode I (Jack)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: 10% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 10% for the next attack

description.name: Dual Awoken Samurai Mode II (Jack)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Samurai abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Samurai abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Dual Carmine Blade when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed (up to six times)

description.name: Dual Carmine Blade
description.text: Two single attacks (4.45 each), ignores DEF, grants [10% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
